## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A six-*juan* Northern-Sòng compiled-essentials commentary on [湛然](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B9%9B%E7%84%B6) Zhànrán's *Zhǐguān yìlì* ([KR6d0132](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0132), T1913) by [從義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E7%BE%A9) Cóngyì (1042–1091), the Northern-Sòng *shānjiā* 山家 Tiāntái master from Píngyáng 平陽. The work belongs together with Cóngyì's *Sāndàbù bǔzhù* ([KR6d0063](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0063)) as part of his comprehensive Northern-Sòng Tiāntái scholastic apparatus.

**Abstract**

Cóngyì's *Yìlì zuǎnyào* is the principal Northern-Sòng *shānjiā* commentary on Zhànrán's *Zhǐguān yìlì*, articulating the *shānjiā* polemical defense of the Tiāntái doctrinal-meditative tradition against Huāyán-school positions (particularly those of [澄觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%BE%84%E8%A7%80) Chéngguān, 738–839). The work documents the Northern-Sòng Tiāntái-Huāyán doctrinal dispute and the *shānjiā* tradition's institutional consolidation against the Huāyán-school challenge.

The composition is dated to Cóngyì's mature productive period c. 1062–1091.
